3. Additional Context on the document and question asked
The document provided is the official Doctor Who Series 9 Episode 11 “Heaven Sent” script. In this episode the Doctor is confined within a mysterious, constantly reconfiguring castle that functions as a maze designed to torment him. The question requested that we extract the exact wording – including all formatting and punctuation – of the first scene heading that identifies this maze. Although the word “maze” does not appear verbatim in the heading, “INT. THE CASTLE - DAY” is the very first scene heading in the script. In the episode’s context the castle is depicted as an ever‐shifting labyrinth (or maze) through which the Doctor must navigate, and this scene heading sets the stage for that environment.
`
